nodes.snippet: All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of the next Kalpa.

nodes.label: BG 9.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless under the force of Nature.

nodes.label: BG 9.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
nodes.snippet: These acts do not bind Me, O Arjuna, sitting as one indifferent, unattached to those acts.

nodes.label: BG 9.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Under Me, as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; therefore, O Arjuna, the world revolves.

nodes.label: BG 9.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of all beings.

nodes.label: BG 9.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings, filled with vain hopes, vain actions, and vain knowledge that is senseless.

nodes.label: BG 9.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single-minded devotion, knowing Me as the imperishable source of all beings.

nodes.label: BG 9.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Always glorifying Me, striving, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with steadfast devotion.

nodes.label: BG 9.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Others also, sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice, worship Me, the All-Faced, as one, distinct, and manifold.

nodes.label: BG 9.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I am Kratu; I am Yajna; I am the offering to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the ghee or melted butter; I am the fire; I am the…

nodes.label: BG 9.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions, and the grandfather; the one thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (Om),…

nodes.label: BG 9.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्
nodes.snippet: I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house, and the imperishable seed.

nodes.label: BG 9.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: As the sun, I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 9.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me through sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord…

nodes.label: BG 9.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the three (Vedas) and desiring objects of…

nodes.label: BG 9.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no one else, for those ever-united, I secure what they have not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.

nodes.label: BG 9.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, but by the wrong method.

nodes.label: BG 9.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च
nodes.snippet: For I alone am the enjoyer and Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality, and thus they return to this mortal world.

nodes.label: BG 9.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The worshippers of the gods go to them; the ancestor-worshippers go to the manes; the worshippers of the deities who preside over the elements go to them; but My devotees come…

nodes.label: BG 9.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति
nodes.snippet: Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or a little water, that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept.

nodes.label: BG 9.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer in sacrifice, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna, do it as an offering to Me.

nodes.label: BG 9.28
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Thus, you shall be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, you shall come to Me.

nodes.label: BG 9.29
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः
nodes.snippet: I am the same to all beings; there is none hateful or dear to Me; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me, and I am also in them.

nodes.label: BG 9.30
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to no one else, he should indeed be regarded as righteous, for he has rightly resolved.

nodes.label: BG 9.31
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Soon he becomes righteous and attains eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes.

nodes.label: BG 9.32
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः
nodes.snippet: For, taking refuge in Me, they who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth—women, Vaisyas, and Sudras—attain the Supreme Goal.

nodes.label: BG 9.33
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: How much more easily, then, do Brahmins and devoted royal saints attain the goal? Having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me.

nodes.label: BG 9.34
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
nodes.snippet: Fix your mind on Me; be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; bow down to Me; having thus united your whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, you will come to Me.

nodes.label: BG 10.1
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, Again, O mighty-armed Arjuna, listen to my supreme word which I will declare to you, who are beloved, for your welfare.

nodes.label: BG 10.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः
nodes.snippet: Neither the hosts of the gods nor the great sages know My origin; for I am the source of all the gods and the great sages in every way.

nodes.label: BG 10.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who knows Me as unborn and beginningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded and is liberated from all sins.

nodes.label: BG 10.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Intellect, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, happiness, pain, existence or birth, non-existence or death, fear, and also fearlessness.

nodes.label: BG 10.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Non-injury, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and ill-fame—these different qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

nodes.label: BG 10.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The seven great sages, the ancient four, and the Manus, possessing powers like Mine (due to their minds being fixed on Me), were born from My mind; from them, these creatures…

nodes.label: BG 10.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
nodes.snippet: He who truly knows these manifold manifestations of My Being and this Yoga-power of Mine, becomes established in unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it.

nodes.label: BG 10.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते
nodes.snippet: I am the source of all; from me everything evolves; Understanding this, the wise, endowed with meditation, worship me.

nodes.label: BG 10.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: With their minds and lives wholly absorbed in Me, they enlighten each other and ever speak of Me, being satisfied and delighted.

nodes.label: BG 10.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: To those who are ever steadfast, worshipping me with love, I give the yoga of discrimination, by which they come to me.

nodes.label: BG 10.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Out of mere compassion for them, I, dwelling within their selves, destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.

nodes.label: BG 10.12
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.sa: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, eternal, divine Person, the primeval God, unborn, and omnipresent."

nodes.label: BG 10.13
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: All the sages have thus declared Thee, as also the divine sage Narada; so also Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and now Thou Thyself dost say so to me.

nodes.label: BG 10.14
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I believe all that You have said to me to be true, O Krishna; indeed, O blessed Lord! Neither the gods nor the demons know Your manifestation (origin).

nodes.label: BG 10.15
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Supreme Person, O source and Lord of all beings, O God of gods, O ruler of the world!

nodes.label: BG 10.16
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: You should indeed tell, without reserve, of your divine glories by which you exist, pervading all these worlds. (No one else can do so.)

nodes.label: BG 10.17
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: How shall I, ever meditating, know you, O Yogin? In what aspects or things, O blessed Lord, should I think of you?

nodes.label: BG 10.18
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Tell me again in detail, O Krishna, of your yogic power and glory; for I am not satiated with what I have heard of your life-giving and nectar-like speech.

nodes.label: BG 10.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "Very well! Now I will declare to you My divine glories in their prominence, O Arjuna; there is no end to their detailed description."

nodes.label: BG 10.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.

nodes.label: BG 10.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the twelve Adityas, I am Vishnu; among luminaries, the radiant sun; among the seven or forty-nine Maruts, I am Marichi; among stars, I am the moon.

nodes.label: BG 10.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-Veda; among the gods, I am Vasava; among the senses, I am the mind; and among living beings, I am intelligence.

nodes.label: BG 10.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And among the Rudras, I am Sankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, the Lord of Wealth (Kubera); among the Vasus, I am Pavaka (Fire); and among the seven mountains, I am Meru.

nodes.label: BG 10.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्
nodes.snippet: And, among the household priests of kings, O Arjuna, know Me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among the army generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean.

nodes.label: BG 10.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu; among words, I am the one syllable (Om); among sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of silent repetition; among the immovable things, I am the…

nodes.label: BG 10.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among all the trees, I am the Peepul; among the divine sages, I am Narada; among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha; among the perfected, I am the sage Kapila.

nodes.label: BG 10.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Know Me as Ucchaisravas, born of nectar, among horses; Airavata among lordly elephants; and the king among men.

nodes.label: BG 10.28
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow called Kamadhenu; I am the progenitor, the god of love; among serpents, I am Vasuki.

nodes.label: BG 10.29
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I am Ananta among the Nagas; I am Varuna among water-deities; Aryaman among the Manes; I am Yama among the governors.

nodes.label: BG 10.30
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And I am Prahlada among the demons, I am Time among reckoners, I am the lion among beasts, and Vainateya (Garuda) among birds.

nodes.label: BG 10.31
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the purifiers, I am the wind; among the warriors, I am Rama; among the fishes, I am the shark; among the streams, I am the Ganga.

nodes.label: BG 10.32
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among creations I am the beginning, the middle, and the end, O Arjuna; among the sciences, I am the science of the Self; and I am the logic among controversialists.

nodes.label: BG 10.33
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the letters of the alphabet, I am the letter 'A' and the dual among compounds. I am verily the inexhaustible and everlasting time; I am the dispenser of the fruits of…

nodes.label: BG 10.34
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And I am the all-devouring Death, and the source of prosperity for those who are to be prosperous; among the feminine qualities, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory,…

nodes.label: BG 10.35
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the hymns, I am the Brihatsaman; among meters, I am Gayatri; among months, I am Margasirsha; among seasons, I am the flowery season.

nodes.label: BG 10.36
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I am the gambling of the deceitful; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am the resolve of the resolute; I am the goodness of the good.

nodes.label: BG 10.37
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vaasudeva; among the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; among the sages, I am Vyasa; among the poets, I am Usanas, the poet.

nodes.label: BG 10.38
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Of those who punish, I am the scepter; among those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; and among secrets, I am silence; I am knowledge among knowers.

nodes.label: BG 10.39
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that too am I, O Arjuna; there is no being, be it moving or unmoving, that can exist without Me.

nodes.label: BG 10.40
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: There is no end to My divine glories, O Arjuna, but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine glory.

nodes.label: BG 10.41
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Whatever being there is glorious, prosperous, or powerful, know that to be a manifestation of a part of My splendor.

nodes.label: BG 10.42
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But, of what avail is the knowledge of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I exist, supporting this whole world with one part of Myself.

nodes.label: BG 11.1
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, By this explanation of the highest secret concerning the Self which Thou hast spoken, for the sake of blessing me, my delusion has been dispelled.

nodes.label: BG 11.2
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.sa: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया
nodes.snippet: The origin and destruction of beings have been heard in detail from You, O lotus-eyed Lord, and also Your inexhaustible greatness.

nodes.label: BG 11.3
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Now, O Supreme Lord, as Thou hast thus described Thyself, O Supreme Person, I wish to behold Thy divine form.

nodes.label: BG 11.4
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.sa: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो
nodes.snippet: If Thou, O Lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do Thou, then, O Lord of the Yogis, show me Thy imperishable Self.

nodes.label: BG 11.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, forms of Mine, by the hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, divine, and of various colors and shapes."

nodes.label: BG 11.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts; behold many wonders never before seen, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 11.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Now, behold, O Arjuna, in this My body, the entire universe centered in one, including the moving and the unmoving, and whatever else you desire to see.

nodes.label: BG 11.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा
nodes.snippet: But you are not able to behold Me with these your own eyes; I give you the divine eye; behold My lordly Yoga.

nodes.label: BG 11.9
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken, O king, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari (Krishna), showed Arjuna His supreme form as the Lord.

nodes.label: BG 11.10
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: With numerous mouths and eyes, with numerous wondrous sights, with numerous divine adornments, with numerous divine weapons uplifted, such a form He showed.

nodes.label: BG 11.11
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Wearing divine garlands and apparel, anointed with divine unguents, the all-wonderful, resplendent Being is endless with faces on all sides.

nodes.label: BG 11.12
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out simultaneously in the sky, that would be the splendour of that mighty being.

nodes.label: BG 11.13
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: There, in the body of the God of gods, Arjuna then saw the entire universe resting in one, with its myriad of divisions.

nodes.label: BG 11.14
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Then, Arjuna, filled with wonder and his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the God and spoke with palms joined.

nodes.label: BG 11.15
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "O God, I see all the gods in Your body, as well as hosts of various classes of beings, Brahma the Lord seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the celestial…

nodes.label: BG 11.16
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I see You with boundless form on every side, with many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes; neither the end nor the middle nor the beginning do I see, O Lord of the Universe, O…

nodes.label: BG 11.17
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I see You with the diadem, club, and discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, very hard to look at, blazing all around like a burning fire and the sun, and immeasurable.

nodes.label: BG 11.18
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: You are the Imperishable, the Supreme Being, worthy of being known. You are the great treasure-house of this universe; You are the imperishable protector of the eternal Dharma;…

nodes.label: BG 11.19
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I see You without beginning, middle, or end, infinite in power, with endless arms, the sun and moon as Your eyes, the burning fire Your mouth, heating the entire universe with…

nodes.label: BG 11.20
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: This space between the earth and the heavens, and all the quarters, is filled by You alone; having seen this, Your wonderful and terrible form, the three worlds are trembling…

nodes.label: BG 11.21
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Verily, these hosts of gods enter into Thee; some extol Thee with joined palms in fear, saying, 'May it be well!' Bands of great sages and perfected ones praise Thee with…

nodes.label: BG 11.22
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus, Sadhyas, Visvedevas, the two Asvins, Maruts, the Manus, and the hosts of celestial singers, Yakshas, demons, and the perfected ones, all look upon…

nodes.label: BG 11.23
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Having seen Your immeasurable form with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs and fearsome with many teeth, the worlds…

nodes.label: BG 11.24
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: On seeing Thee, touching the sky, shining in many colors, with mouths wide open, with large fiery eyes, I am terrified at heart and find neither courage nor peace, O Vishnu.

nodes.label: BG 11.25
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Having seen Thy mouths fearful with teeth blazing like the fires of cosmic dissolution, I know not the four quarters, nor do I find peace. Have mercy, O Lord of the gods, O…

nodes.label: BG 11.26
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: All the sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of kings of the earth, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the chief among our warriors.

nodes.label: BG 11.27
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Some hurry into Your mouths with their terrible teeth, fearful to behold. Some are found stuck in the gaps between the teeth, their heads crushed to powder.

nodes.label: BG 11.28
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Verily, just as many torrents of rivers flow towards the ocean, so too these heroes in the world of men enter Thy flaming mouths.

nodes.label: BG 11.29
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: As moths hurriedly rush into a blazing fire, leading to their own destruction, so too these creatures hurry into Your mouths, leading to their own destruction.

nodes.label: BG 11.30
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Thou lickest up, devouring all the worlds on every side with Thy flaming mouths. Thy fierce rays, filling the whole world with radiance, burn, O Vishnu!

nodes.label: BG 11.31
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Tell me, who you are, so fierce of form. I offer my salutations to you, O God Supreme; have mercy on me. I desire to know you, the original Being. I do not indeed know your…

nodes.label: BG 11.32
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "I am the full-grown, world-destroying Time, now engaged in destroying the worlds. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed in the hostile armies…

nodes.label: BG 11.33
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Therefore, stand up and obtain fame. Conquer the enemies and enjoy the unparalleled kingdom. Verily, by Me they have already been slain; be thou a mere instrument, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 11.34
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
nodes.snippet: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors have already been slain by Me; do not be distressed with fear; fight and you shall conquer your enemies in battle.

nodes.label: BG 11.35
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Sanjaya said, Having heard that speech of Lord Krishna, Arjuna, with joined palms, trembling, prostrated himself, again addressing Krishna in a choked voice, bowing down,…

nodes.label: BG 11.36
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "It is fitting, O Krishna, that the world delights and rejoices in Your praise; demons fly in fear in all directions and the hosts of the perfected ones bow to You."

nodes.label: BG 11.37
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: And why should they not, O great Soul, bow to Thee Who art greater than all else, the primal cause even of the Creator (Brahma), O Infinite Being, O Lord of the gods, O Abode…

nodes.label: BG 11.38
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: You are the primal God, the ancient Purusha, the supreme refuge of this universe, the knower, the knowable, and the supreme Abode. Through You, the universe is pervaded, O…

nodes.label: BG 11.39
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, the Creator, and the great-grandfather. I offer my salutations to You a thousand times, and again I offer my salutations to You.

nodes.label: BG 11.40
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Salutations to You in front and behind! Salutations to You on every side! O All! You, infinite in power and prowess, pervade all; therefore You are all.

nodes.label: BG 11.41
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Whatever I have presumptuously said from carelessness or love, addressing You as O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend! regarding You merely as a friend, unknowing of Your greatness.

nodes.label: BG 11.42
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: In whatever way I may have insulted You for the sake of fun, while at play, reposing, sitting, or at meals, when alone (with You), O Krishna, or in company, that I implore You,…

nodes.label: BG 11.43
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Thou art the Father of this world, both moving and unmoving. Thou art to be adored by this world; Thou, the greatest Guru; for none exists who is equal to Thee; how then could…

nodes.label: BG 11.44
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Therefore, bowing down and prostrating my body, I crave Thy forgiveness, O adorable Lord. As a father forgives his son, a friend his dear friend, a lover his beloved, even so…

nodes.label: BG 11.45
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I am delighted, having seen something never seen before; yet my mind is distressed with fear. Show me that form only, O God; have mercy, O God of gods, O Abode of the universe.

nodes.label: BG 11.46
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: I desire to see You as before, crowned, bearing a mace, with the discus in hand, in Your former form only, having four arms, O thousand-armed, Cosmic Being.

nodes.label: BG 11.47
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this Cosmic Form has graciously been shown to you by Me through My own Yogic power. It is full of splendour, primeval, and infinite; this…

nodes.label: BG 11.48
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Neither by the study of the Vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor by severe austerities, can I be seen in this form in the world of men by any other than yourself, O…

nodes.label: BG 11.49
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
nodes.snippet: Do not be afraid, nor be bewildered on seeing such a terrible form of Mine; with your fear dispelled and with a gladdened heart, now behold again this former form of Mine.

nodes.label: BG 11.50
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Krishna again showed His own form. The great Soul, assuming His gentle form, then consoled Arjuna, who was terrified.

nodes.label: BG 11.51
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "Having seen this Thy gentle human form, O Krishna, now I am composed and have been restored to my own nature."

nodes.label: BG 11.52
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "It is very hard indeed to see this form of Mine which thou hast seen; even the gods are ever longing to behold it."

nodes.label: BG 11.53
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया
nodes.snippet: Neither by the Vedas, nor by austerity, nor by gift, nor by sacrifice can I be seen in this form as thou hast seen Me so easily.

nodes.label: BG 11.54
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But by single-minded devotion, I can be known, seen, and entered into in reality, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 11.55
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who does all actions for Me, who regards Me as the Supreme, who is devoted to Me, who is free from attachment, who bears no enmity towards any creature, he comes to Me, O…

nodes.label: BG 12.1
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "Which of them are better versed in Yoga—those who steadfastly worship You, or those who worship the imperishable and the unmanifested?"

nodes.label: BG 12.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "In My opinion, those who fix their minds on Me, worship Me ever steadfastly, and are endowed with supreme faith, are the best in Yoga."

nodes.label: BG 12.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Those who worship the imperishable, the indefinable, the unmanifest, the omnipresent, the unthinkable, the immovable, and the eternal.

nodes.label: BG 12.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Having restrained all the senses, being even-minded everywhere, and intent on the welfare of all beings, they verily come unto Me.

nodes.label: BG 12.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Greater is their trouble whose minds are set on the unmanifested, for the goal of the unmanifested is very hard for the embodied to reach.

nodes.label: BG 12.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः
nodes.snippet: But to those who worship Me, renouncing all actions in Me, regarding Me as the supreme goal, meditating on Me with single-minded yoga.

nodes.label: BG 12.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: To those whose minds are set on Me, O Arjuna, verily I soon become the savior out of the ocean of Samsara.

nodes.label: BG 12.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय
nodes.snippet: Fix your mind on Me, and your intellect in Me. Then you will certainly live in Me alone hereafter.

nodes.label: BG 12.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्
nodes.snippet: If you are unable to fix your mind steadily on Me, then seek to reach Me through the yoga of constant practice, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 12.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: If you are unable to practice even this Abhyasa Yoga, be intent on doing actions for My sake; even by doing actions for My sake, you will attain perfection.

nodes.label: BG 12.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: If you are unable to do even this, then, resort to union with Me and renounce the fruits of all actions with self-control.

nodes.label: BG 12.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Better indeed is knowledge than practice; better than knowledge is meditation; better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of actions: peace immediately follows…

nodes.label: BG 12.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च
nodes.snippet: He who hates no creature, is friendly and compassionate to all, is free from attachment and egoism, is balanced in pleasure and pain, and is forgiving.

nodes.label: BG 12.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Ever content, steady in meditation, self-controlled, possessing firm conviction, with the mind and intellect dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 12.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He whom the world does not agitate, and who cannot be agitated by the world, and who is freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety—he is dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 12.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who is free from wants, pure, expert, unconcerned, and free from pain, renouncing all undertakings and commencements, he who is devoted to Me is dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 12.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
nodes.snippet: He who neither rejoices nor hates, nor grieves nor desires, renouncing both good and evil, and who is full of devotion, is dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 12.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः
nodes.snippet: He who is the same to foe and friend, and also in honor and dishonor, who is the same in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, and who is free from attachment.

nodes.label: BG 12.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He to whom censure and praise are equal, who is silent, content with anything, homeless, of a steady mind, and full of devotion; that man is dear to me.

nodes.label: BG 12.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They who follow this immortal Dharma, endowed with faith and regarding Me as their supreme goal, are exceedingly dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 13.1
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.sa: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "I wish to learn about Nature and the Spirit, the field and the knower of the field, knowledge and that which ought to be known, O Kesava."

nodes.label: BG 13.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "O Arjuna, this body is called the field; he who knows it is called the knower of the field by those who know them."

nodes.label: BG 13.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत
nodes.snippet: Do thou also know Me as the knower of the field in all fields, O Arjuna. Knowledge of both the field and the knower of the field is considered by Me to be the knowledge.

nodes.label: BG 13.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्
nodes.snippet: Hear from Me in brief what the field is, of what nature it is, what its modifications are, whence it is, who He is, and what His powers are.

nodes.label: BG 13.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Sages have sung in many ways, with various distinctive chants and also with suggestive words indicative of the Absolute, full of reasoning and decisive.

nodes.label: BG 13.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The great elements, egoism, intellect, and also the Unmanifested Nature, the ten senses, and one mind, and the five objects of the senses.

nodes.label: BG 13.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate (body), intelligence, and fortitude—the field has thus been briefly described with its modifications.

nodes.label: BG 13.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Humility, unpretentiousness, non-injury, forgiveness, uprightness, service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, and self-control.

nodes.label: BG 13.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Indifference to the objects of the senses and also absence of egoism; perceiving the evil in birth, death, old age, sickness, and pain.

nodes.label: BG 13.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Non-attachment, non-identification of the Self with son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant even-mindedness in the face of the attainment of both desirable and undesirable.

nodes.label: BG 13.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Unswerving devotion to Me through the Yoga of non-separation, resorting to solitary places, and a distaste for the company of people.

nodes.label: BG 13.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Constancy in Self-knowledge, the perception of the end of true knowledge—this is declared to be knowledge, and what is opposed to it is ignorance.

nodes.label: BG 13.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: I will declare that which is to be known, knowing which one attains immortality; the beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is neither being nor non-being.

nodes.label: BG 13.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads, and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the worlds, enveloping all.

nodes.label: BG 13.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Shining by the functions of all the senses, yet without being attached to them; unattached, yet supporting all; devoid of qualities, yet the experiencer of them.

nodes.label: BG 13.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: It is within and without all beings, both the unmoving and the moving; It is subtle and unknowable, and It is near and far away.

nodes.label: BG 13.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्
nodes.snippet: Undivided yet, It exists as if divided in beings; It is to be known as the supporter of beings; It devours and It generates.

nodes.label: BG 13.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That Light of all lights is said to be beyond darkness: knowledge, the knowable, and the goal of knowledge, seated in the hearts of all.

nodes.label: BG 13.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः
nodes.snippet: Thus, the field, as well as knowledge and the knowable, have been briefly stated. My devotee, knowing this, enters into My being.

nodes.label: BG 13.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Know that Nature (matter) and the Spirit are both beginningless, and know also that all modifications and qualities are born from Nature.

nodes.label: BG 13.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: In the production of the effect and the cause, Nature (matter) is said to be the cause; in the experience of pleasure and pain, the soul is said to be the one responsible.

nodes.label: BG 13.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The soul seated in Nature experiences the qualities born of Nature; attachment to the qualities is the cause of its birth in good and evil wombs.

nodes.label: BG 13.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Supreme Soul in this body is also called the observer, the permitter, the sustainer, the enjoyer, the great Lord, and the Supreme Self.

nodes.label: BG 13.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह
nodes.snippet: He who thus knows the Spirit and Matter together with their qualities, in whatever condition he may be, he is not reborn.

nodes.label: BG 13.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Some behold the Self within themselves through meditation, others through the Yoga of knowledge, and still others through the Yoga of action.

nodes.label: BG 13.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Others, too, who do not know thus, worship, having heard of It from others; they, too, cross beyond death, regarding what they have heard as the supreme refuge.

nodes.label: BG 13.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Wherever a being is born, whether unmoving or moving, know thou, O best of the Bharatas (Arjuna), that it is from the union of the field and its knower.

nodes.label: BG 13.28
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who sees the Supreme Lord existing truly in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable, sees indeed.

nodes.label: BG 13.29
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: For he who truly sees the same Lord dwelling everywhere does not destroy the Self by the self; rather, he attains the highest goal.

nodes.label: BG 13.30
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He sees, who sees that all actions are performed solely by Nature and that the Self is without action.

nodes.label: BG 13.31
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: When a person sees all beings as resting in the One and emanating from the One alone, they then become Brahman.

nodes.label: BG 13.32
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Being without beginning, devoid of any qualities, the Supreme Self, imperishable, though dwelling in the body, O Arjuna, neither acts nor is tainted.

nodes.label: BG 13.33
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted, due to its subtlety, so the Self seated everywhere in the body is not tainted either.

nodes.label: BG 13.34
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Just as the one sun illuminates the entire world, so too does the Lord of the field (Supreme Self) illuminate the entire field, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 13.35
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They who, by the eye of knowledge, perceive the distinction between the field and its knower, as well as the liberation from the Nature of being, go to the Supreme.

nodes.label: BG 14.1
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "I will again declare to thee that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to supreme perfection after…

nodes.label: BG 14.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Those who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor disturbed at the time of dissolution.

nodes.label: BG 14.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: My womb is the great Brahma; in it I place the germ; thence, O Arjuna, is the birth of all beings.

nodes.label: BG 14.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Whatever forms are produced, O Arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma is their womb, and I am the seed-giving father.

nodes.label: BG 14.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: These qualities, O Arjuna, born of Nature, bind fast in the body of the embodied, the indestructible: purity, passion, and inertia.

nodes.label: BG 14.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Of these, sattva, which is luminous and healthy due to its stainlessness, binds one by attachment to happiness and knowledge, O sinless one.

nodes.label: BG 14.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Know, O Arjuna, that Rajas is of the nature of passion, the source of thirst and attachment; it binds fast the embodied one by attachment to action.

nodes.label: BG 14.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But know thou Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Arjuna, through heedlessness, indolence, and sleep.

nodes.label: BG 14.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत
nodes.snippet: Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Arjuna, while Tamas, verily shrouding knowledge, attaches to heedlessness.

nodes.label: BG 14.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Now, O Arjuna, Sattva prevails, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; then Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and then Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.

nodes.label: BG 14.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: When the wisdom-light shines through every gate of this body, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.

nodes.label: BG 14.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, and longing—these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 14.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Darkness, inertia, carelessness, and delusion—these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 14.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्
nodes.snippet: If the embodied one meets death when Sattva is predominant, then they attain the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest.

nodes.label: BG 14.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the thoughtless.

nodes.label: BG 14.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They say that the fruit of good action is Sattvic and pure; indeed, the fruit of Rajas is pain, and the fruit of Tamas is ignorance.

nodes.label: BG 14.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च
nodes.snippet: From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.

nodes.label: BG 14.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः
nodes.snippet: Those seated in Sattva ascend; those of Rajasic nature dwell in the middle; and those of Tamasic nature, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, descend.

nodes.label: BG 14.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows that which is higher than them, he attains to My Being.

nodes.label: BG 14.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The embodied one, having crossed beyond these three Gunas from which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay, and pain, and attains immortality.

nodes.label: BG 14.21
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "What are the marks of one who has transcended the three qualities, O Lord? What is their conduct, and how do they go beyond these three qualities?"

nodes.label: BG 14.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "When light, activity, and delusion are present, he does not hate them, nor does he long for them when they are absent.

nodes.label: BG 14.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the dualities, and who, knowing that the dualities are active, is self-centered and does not move.

nodes.label: BG 14.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold are all alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is…

nodes.label: BG 14.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Who is the same in honor and dishonor, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings, he is said to have transcended the dualities.

nodes.label: BG 14.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And he who serves Me with unwavering devotion, he, crossing beyond the dualities, is fit for becoming Brahman.

nodes.label: BG 14.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal, immutable, and everlasting Dharma, and absolute bliss.

nodes.label: BG 15.1
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said: They (the wise) speak of the indestructible peepul tree, with its roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the meters or hymns; he who knows it…

nodes.label: BG 15.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Its branches spread below and above, nourished by the Gunas; its buds are sense-objects, and its roots stretch forth below in the world of men, originating action.

nodes.label: BG 15.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते    नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा
nodes.snippet: Its form is not perceived here as such, nor its end, origin, foundation, or resting place; having cut asunder this firmly rooted peepul tree with the strong axe of non-attachment.

nodes.label: BG 15.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य    यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः
nodes.snippet: Then, that goal should be sought for, to which, having gone, none returns again. I seek refuge in that Primeval Purusha, from whence streamed forth the ancient activity or energy.

nodes.label: BG 15.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Free from pride and delusion, victorious over the evil of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self, their desires having completely turned away, freed from the pairs of…

nodes.label: BG 15.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः
nodes.snippet: Neither does the sun illuminate there, nor the moon, nor the fire; having gone there, they do not return; that is My supreme abode.

nodes.label: BG 15.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: An eternal portion of Myself having become a living soul in the world of life, draws to itself the five senses, with the mind as the sixth, abiding in Nature.

nodes.label: BG 15.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: When the Lord, as the individual soul, obtains a body and when He leaves it, He takes these with Him, just as the wind takes the scents from their seats (flowers, etc.).

nodes.label: BG 15.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च
nodes.snippet: Presiding over the ears, eyes, touch, taste, smell, and mind, it enjoys the objects of the senses.

nodes.label: BG 15.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्
nodes.snippet: The deluded do not see Him who departs, stays, and enjoys; but those who possess the eye of knowledge behold Him.

nodes.label: BG 15.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The yogis striving for perfection behold Him dwelling in the Self; but, the unrefined and unintelligent, even though striving, do not see Him.

nodes.label: BG 15.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That light which resides in the sun, illuminating the whole world; that which is in the moon and in the fire—know that light to be Mine.

nodes.label: BG 15.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Permeating the earth, I support all beings with My energy; and having become the watery moon, I nourish all herbs.

nodes.label: BG 15.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Having become the fire Vaisvanara, I abide in the bodies of living beings and, associated with the Prana and the Apana, digest the fourfold food.

nodes.label: BG 15.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो    मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च
nodes.snippet: And I am seated in the hearts of all; from Me come memory and knowledge, as well as their absence. I am verily That which has to be known by all the Vedas; I am indeed the…

nodes.label: BG 15.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च
nodes.snippet: Two Purushas there are in this world: the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable, and the Kutastha—the unchanging—is called the imperishable.

nodes.label: BG 15.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But distinct is the Supreme Purusha, called the highest Self, indestructible and Lord, who pervades the three worlds and sustains them.

nodes.label: BG 15.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: As I transcend the perishable and am even higher than the imperishable, I am declared to be the highest Purusha in the world and in the Vedas.

nodes.label: BG 15.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who, undeluded, knows Me as the highest Purusha, he, knowing all, worships Me with his whole being (heart), O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 15.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Thus, I have imparted to you this most secret science, O sinless one; by knowing this, one becomes wise, and all their duties are accomplished, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 16.1
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, purity of heart, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, almsgiving, control of the senses, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and…

nodes.label: BG 16.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Harmlessness, truth, absence of anger, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion for beings, non-covetousness, gentleness, modesty, and absence of fickleness.

nodes.label: BG 16.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Vigor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of hatred, absence of pride—these belong to one born for a divine state, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 16.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Hypocrisy, arrogance, and self-conceit, anger, harshness, and ignorance—these belong to one who is born for a demoniacal state, O Partha.

nodes.label: BG 16.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The divine nature is deemed conducive to liberation, and the demonic to bondage. Grieve not, O Arjuna, for you are born with divine endowments.

nodes.label: BG 16.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च
nodes.snippet: There are two types of beings in this world: the divine and the demoniacal. The divine has been described at length; hear from Me, O Arjuna, about the demoniacal.

nodes.label: BG 16.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः
nodes.snippet: The demoniacal do not know what to do and what to refrain from; they have neither purity, nor right conduct, nor truth.

nodes.label: BG 16.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They say, "This universe is without truth, without a moral basis, without a God, brought about by mutual union, with lust as its cause; what else?"

nodes.label: BG 16.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Holding this view, these ruined souls of small intellect and fierce deeds come forth as enemies of the world, intent on its destruction.

nodes.label: BG 16.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Filled with insatiable desires, full of hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding evil ideas due to delusion, they work with impure intentions.

nodes.label: BG 16.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Giving themselves over to immeasurable cares that end only with death, regarding the gratification of lust as their highest aim, and feeling sure that that is all.

nodes.label: BG 16.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Bound by a hundred ties of hope, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain hoards of wealth by unlawful means for sensual enjoyment.

nodes.label: BG 16.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: "I have gained this today; I will fulfill this desire of mine; this is mine, and this wealth will be mine in the future."

nodes.label: BG 16.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: "I have slain that enemy, and I shall slay others too. I am the Lord; I enjoy, I am perfect, powerful, and happy."

nodes.label: BG 16.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: "I am wealthy and born into a noble family. Who is my equal? I shall perform sacrifices, give charity, and rejoice," thus deluded by ignorance.

nodes.label: BG 16.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Bewildered by many fancies, entangled in the snare of delusion, addicted to the gratification of lust, they fall into a foul hell.

nodes.label: BG 16.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices in name only for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinances.

nodes.label: BG 16.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः
nodes.snippet: Given over to egoism, power, haughtiness, lust, and anger, these malicious people hate Me in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.

nodes.label: BG 16.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Those cruel haters, the worst among men in the world, I hurl those evil-doers into the wombs of demons only.

nodes.label: BG 16.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Entering into demoniacal wombs and deluded, birth after birth, they do not attain Me, thus falling, O Arjuna, into a condition still lower than that.

nodes.label: BG 16.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: There are three gates to this hell, destructive of the self: lust, anger, and greed; therefore, one should abandon these three.

nodes.label: BG 16.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: A person who is liberated from these three gates of darkness, O Arjuna, practices what is beneficial for them and thus goes to the Supreme Goal.

nodes.label: BG 16.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the scriptures, acts under the impulse of desire, does not attain perfection, nor happiness, nor the Supreme Goal.

nodes.label: BG 16.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Therefore, let the scripture be thy authority in determining what ought to be done and what ought not to be done. Having known what is said in the ordinance of the scriptures,…

nodes.label: BG 17.1
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "What is the condition of those who, disregarding the injunctions of the scriptures, perform sacrifice with faith—is it Sattva, Rajas, or Tamas, O Krishna?"

nodes.label: BG 17.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "There are threefold faiths inherent in the nature of the embodied: the sattvic (pure), the rajasic (passionate), and the tamasic (dark). Hear of them."

nodes.label: BG 17.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The faith of each is in accordance with their nature, O Arjuna. People consist of their faith; as a person's faith is, so are they.

nodes.label: BG 17.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The sattvic, or pure, men worship the gods; the rajasic, or passionate, worship the yakshas and rakshasas; the others, the tamasic or deluded people, worship ghosts and hosts…

nodes.label: BG 17.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः
nodes.snippet: Those men who practice terrific austerities not prescribed by the scriptures, given to hypocrisy and egoism, driven by the force of lust and attachment.

nodes.label: BG 17.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Know thou these to be of demonical resolves, senselessly torturing all the elements in the body and Me who dwell in the body.

nodes.label: BG 17.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The food that is dear to each is threefold, as well as sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Hear the distinction of these.

nodes.label: BG 17.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The foods that increase life, purity, strength, health, joy, and cheerfulness (good appetite), which are savory, oily, substantial, and agreeable, are dear to the Sattvic…

nodes.label: BG 17.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning are liked by the Rajasic and are productive of pain, grief, and disease.

nodes.label: BG 17.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्
nodes.snippet: That which is stale, tasteless, putrid, rotten, rejected, and impure is the food liked by the Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 17.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for reward, as enjoined by the ordinance (scripture), with a firm faith that doing so is their duty, is Sattvic or pure.

nodes.label: BG 17.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्
nodes.snippet: The sacrifice that is offered, O Arjuna, seeking a reward and for show, know that to be a Rajasic Yajna.

nodes.label: BG 17.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: They declare that sacrifice to be Tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances of the scriptures, in which no food is distributed, and which is devoid of mantras, gifts, and faith.

nodes.label: BG 17.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers, and the wise; purity, straightforwardness, celibacy, and non-injury are all called the austerities of the body.

nodes.label: BG 17.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्
nodes.snippet: Speech that causes no excitement, is truthful, pleasant, and beneficial; the practice of studying the Vedas is called austerity of speech.

nodes.label: BG 17.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Serenity of mind, good-heartedness, self-control, and purity of nature—this is called mental austerity.

nodes.label: BG 17.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: This threefold austerity, practiced by steadfast men, with the utmost faith, desiring no reward, is called Sattvic.

nodes.label: BG 17.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The austerity that is practiced with the aim of gaining good reception, honor, and worship, and with hypocrisy, is said to be Rajasic, unstable, and transient.

nodes.label: BG 17.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of destroying another, is declared to be of the Tamasic nature.

nodes.label: BG 17.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That gift which is given to one who does nothing in return, knowing it to be a duty to give in a suitable place and time to a worthy person, is held to be Sattvic.

nodes.label: BG 17.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: And, that gift which is given with the intention of receiving something in return, or expecting a reward, or begrudgingly, is considered to be Rajasic.

nodes.label: BG 17.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The gift that is given in the wrong place and at the wrong time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, is declared to be of a Tamasic nature.

nodes.label: BG 17.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: "Om Tat Sat": This has been declared to be the triple designation of Brahman. By that, the Brahmanas, the Vedas, and the sacrifices were created formerly.

nodes.label: BG 17.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Therefore, with the utterance of "Om," the acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, are always begun by the students of Brahman.

nodes.label: BG 17.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Uttering "Tat," without aiming for the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice, austerity, and the various acts of gifts performed by those seeking liberation.

nodes.label: BG 17.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The word "Sat" is used to refer to reality and goodness; likewise, O Arjuna, the word "Sat" is used to refer to an auspicious act.

nodes.label: BG 17.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते
nodes.snippet: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity, and gift is also called 'Sat', and action in connection with these, or for the sake of the Supreme, is also called 'Sat'.

nodes.label: BG 17.28
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्
nodes.snippet: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or performed, and whatever austerity is practiced without faith, it is called 'Asat', O Arjuna; it is of no value here or hereafter (after death).

nodes.label: BG 18.1
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "O mighty-armed Hrishikesa, I desire to know the essence or truth of renunciation and abandonment severally, O slayer of Kesi."

nodes.label: BG 18.2
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः
nodes.snippet: The Blessed Lord said, "The sages understand sannyasa to be the renunciation of action with desire; the wise declare the abandonment of the fruits of all actions to be tyaga."

nodes.label: BG 18.3
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Some philosophers declare that actions should be abandoned as evil; while others declare that acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be relinquished.

nodes.label: BG 18.4
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम
nodes.snippet: Hear from Me the conclusion or the final truth about this abandonment, O best of the Bharatas; abandonment, indeed, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.

nodes.label: BG 18.5
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Acts of sacrifice, gift, and austerity should not be abandoned, but should be performed; for sacrifice, gift, and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.

nodes.label: BG 18.6
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च
nodes.snippet: But even these actions should be performed, leaving aside attachment and the desire for rewards, O Arjuna; this is my certain and most assured conviction.

nodes.label: BG 18.7
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Verily, the renunciation of obligatory action is not proper; the abandonment of the same out of delusion is declared to be Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.8
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who abandons action out of fear of bodily trouble (because it is painful), does not obtain the merit of renunciation by performing such Rajasic renunciation.

nodes.label: BG 18.9
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Whatever obligatory action is done, O Arjuna, merely because it ought to be done, abandoning attachment and also the desire for reward, that renunciation is regarded as sattvic…

nodes.label: BG 18.10
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The man of renunciation, pervaded by purity, intelligent, and with his doubts cut asunder, does not hate an unpleasant task nor is he attached to a pleasant one.

nodes.label: BG 18.11
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः
nodes.snippet: Indeed, it is not possible for an embodied being to completely abandon actions; however, he who relinquishes the rewards of actions is truly called a man of renunciation.

nodes.label: BG 18.12
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्
nodes.snippet: The threefold fruit of action (evil, good, and mixed) accrues after death to those who do not abandon it, but never to those who do.

nodes.label: BG 18.13
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Learn from Me, O mighty-armed Arjuna, these five causes, as declared in the Sankhya system, for the accomplishment of all actions.

nodes.label: BG 18.14
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्
nodes.snippet: The body, the doer, the various senses, the different functions of various kinds, and the presiding deity—the fifth.

nodes.label: BG 18.15
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Whatever action a person performs with their body, speech, and mind, whether right or wrong, these five are its causes.

nodes.label: BG 18.16
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः
nodes.snippet: Now, such being the case, verily he who, owing to an untrained understanding, looks upon his Self, which is isolated, as the agent, he of perverted intelligence does not see.

nodes.label: BG 18.17
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते
nodes.snippet: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose intelligence is not tainted by good or evil, though he slays these people, he does not slay, nor is he bound by the action.

nodes.label: BG 18.18
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Knowledge, the knowable, and the knower form the threefold impulse for action; the organ, the action, and the agent form the threefold basis of action.

nodes.label: BG 18.19
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः
nodes.snippet: Knowledge, action, and actor are declared in the science of the Gunas (Sankhya philosophy) to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction of the Gunas. Of these, hear…

nodes.label: BG 18.20
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That by which one sees the indestructible Reality in all beings, not separate in any of them—know that knowledge to be Sattvic.

nodes.label: BG 18.21
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But that knowledge which sees in all beings various entities of distinct kinds as being distinct from one another, know thou that knowledge to be Rajasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.22
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But that which clings to one single effect as if it were the whole, without reason, without any foundation in Truth, and is trivial—that is declared to be Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.23
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: An action that is ordained, free from attachment, done without love or hatred, and without desire for reward is declared to be Sattvic.

nodes.label: BG 18.24
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः
nodes.snippet: But that action which is done by one longing for the fulfillment of desires or gain with egotism or with much effort is declared to be Rajasic (passionate).

nodes.label: BG 18.25
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard for the consequences, loss, injury, and one's own ability, is declared to be Tamasic (dark).

nodes.label: BG 18.26
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: An agent who is free from attachment, non-egoistic, endowed with firmness and enthusiasm, and unaffected by success or failure, is considered to be of a Sattvic (pure) nature.

nodes.label: BG 18.27
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Passionate, desiring to obtain the reward of their actions, greedy, cruel, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an agent is said to be Rajasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.28
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Unsteady, vulgar, inflexible, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—such an agent is called Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.29
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Hear thou the threefold division of intellect and firmness, according to the Gunas, as I declare them fully and distinctly, O Arjuna.

nodes.label: BG 18.30
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये
nodes.snippet: The intellect which knows the path of work and renunciation, what should be done and what should not be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation—that intellect is…

nodes.label: BG 18.31
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च
nodes.snippet: That by which one wrongly understands dharma and adharma, and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done—that intellect, O Arjuna, is rajasic (passionate).

nodes.label: BG 18.32
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That intellect, O Arjuna, which is enveloped in darkness and sees Adharma as Dharma and all things perverted, is Tamasic (dark).

nodes.label: BG 18.33
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The unwavering firmness, through which Yoga restrains the functions of the mind, life-force, and senses—that firmness, O Arjuna, is Sattvic (pure).

nodes.label: BG 18.34
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: But that, O Arjuna, by which one holds fast to Dharma (duty), enjoyment of pleasures, and earning of wealth, on account of attachment and desire for reward—that firmness, O…

nodes.label: BG 18.35
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च
nodes.snippet: That firmness, O Arjuna, by which a stupid man does not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and conceit, is Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.36
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ
nodes.snippet: And now, O Arjuna, hear from Me of the threefold pleasure, in which one rejoices through practice and surely comes to the end of pain.

nodes.label: BG 18.37
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That which is like poison at first but in the end like nectar—that happiness is declared to be sattvic, born of the purity of one's own mind due to self-realization.

nodes.label: BG 18.38
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That happiness which arises from the contact of the senses with the objects, which is initially like nectar but eventually like poison, is said to be Rajasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.39
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: That happiness which at first, as well as in the end, deludes the self, and which arises from sleep, indolence, and heedlessness—that is declared to be Tamasic.

nodes.label: BG 18.40
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः
nodes.snippet: There is no being on earth or in heaven among the gods that is liberated from the three qualities born of Nature.

nodes.label: BG 18.41
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras, O Arjuna, the duties are distributed according to the qualities born of their own nature.

nodes.label: BG 18.42
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, and uprightness, as well as knowledge, realization, and belief in God, are the duties of Brahmanas, born of their own…

nodes.label: BG 18.43
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Prowess, splendor, firmness, dexterity, and not fleeing from battle, generosity, and lordliness are the duties of the Kshatriyas, born of their own nature.

nodes.label: BG 18.44
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Agriculture, cattle-rearing, and trade are the duties of the Vaisya (merchant), born of their own nature; and service is the duty of the Sudra (servant-class), born of their…

nodes.label: BG 18.45
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः
nodes.snippet: Each person devoted to their own duty attains perfection. How they attain perfection while being engaged in their own duty, hear now.

nodes.label: BG 18.46
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He from whom all the beings have evolved and by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping Him with his own duty, one attains perfection.

nodes.label: BG 18.47
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Better is one's own duty, even if it is destitute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. He who does the duty ordained by his own nature incurs no sin.

nodes.label: BG 18.48
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्
nodes.snippet: One should not, O Arjuna, abandon the duty to which one is born, though it may be faulty; for, all undertakings are enveloped by evil, just as fire is by smoke.

nodes.label: BG 18.49
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled, he attains the supreme state of freedom from action through renunciation.

nodes.label: BG 18.50
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे
nodes.snippet: Learn from Me, O Arjuna, in brief how one who has attained perfection reaches Brahman—the Eternal, that supreme state of knowledge.

nodes.label: BG 18.51
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च
nodes.snippet: Endowed with a pure intellect, controlling the self through firmness, relinquishing sound and other objects and abandoning attraction and hatred.

nodes.label: BG 18.52
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Dwelling in solitude, eating sparingly, with speech, body, and mind subdued, always engaged in meditation and concentration, and resorting to dispassion.

nodes.label: BG 18.53
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्
nodes.snippet: Having abandoned egoism, strength, arrogance, desire, anger, and covetousness, and being free from the notion of 'mine' and peaceful, he is fit for becoming Brahman.

nodes.label: BG 18.54
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
nodes.snippet: Becoming Brahman, serene in the Self, he neither grieves nor desires; he is the same to all beings, and obtains supreme devotion to Me.

nodes.label: BG 18.55
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: By devotion, he knows Me in truth, who and what I am; then, having known Me in truth, he immediately enters into the Supreme.

nodes.label: BG 18.56
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Having taken refuge in Me and doing all actions, by My grace he obtains the eternal, indestructible state of being.

nodes.label: BG 18.57
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Mentally renouncing all actions in Me, having Me as the highest goal, and resorting to the yoga of discrimination, do thou ever fix thy mind on Me.

nodes.label: BG 18.58
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Fixing your mind on Me, you shall, by My grace, overcome all obstacles; but if you will not hear Me due to egoism, you shall perish.

nodes.label: BG 18.59
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: If, filled with egoism, thou thinkest, "I will not fight," then thy resolve is vain; nature will compel thee.

nodes.label: BG 18.60
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: O Arjuna, bound by your own Karma (action) born of your own nature, that which from delusion you wish not to do, even that you shall do helplessly.

nodes.label: BG 18.61
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, causing all beings, by His illusory power, to revolve as if mounted on a machine.

nodes.label: BG 18.62
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Fly to Him for refuge with all your being, O Arjuna; by His grace you will obtain supreme peace and the eternal abode.

nodes.label: BG 18.63
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Thus, wisdom more secret than secrecy itself has been declared to you by me. Reflect on it fully, then act as you wish.

nodes.label: BG 18.64
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
nodes.snippet: Hear again My supreme word, most secret of all; for you are dearly beloved of Me, I will tell you what is good.

nodes.label: BG 18.65
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
nodes.snippet: Fix your mind on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. You will come to Me; I truly promise you this, for you are dear to Me.

nodes.label: BG 18.66
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Abandon all duties and take refuge in Me alone; I will liberate you from all sins; do not grieve.

nodes.label: BG 18.67
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Never speak this to one who is devoid of austerities or devotion, who does not render service, who does not desire to listen, or who cavils at Me.

nodes.label: BG 18.68
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: He who, with supreme devotion to Me, teaches this supreme secret to My devotees, shall undoubtedly come to Me.

nodes.label: BG 18.69
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: There is no one among men who does service dearer to Me, nor shall there be anyone on earth dearer to Me than him.

nodes.label: BG 18.70
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.sa: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः
nodes.snippet: And he who studies this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped through the sacrifice of wisdom; such is my conviction.

nodes.label: BG 18.71
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Also, the man who hears this, full of faith and free from malice, shall attain to the happy worlds of those of righteous deeds, and be liberated.

nodes.label: BG 18.72
nodes.speaker: krishna
nodes.snippet: Has this been heard, O Arjuna, with one-pointed focus? Has the delusion of your ignorance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

nodes.label: BG 18.73
nodes.speaker: arjuna
nodes.snippet: Arjuna said, "My delusion has been destroyed, for I have gained my knowledge (memory) through Your grace, O Krishna. I am now free from doubts. I will act according to Your word."

nodes.label: BG 18.74
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Sanjaya said, Thus, I have heard this wonderful dialogue between Krishna and the high-souled Arjuna, which causes one's hair to stand on end.

nodes.label: BG 18.75
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: Through the grace of Vyasa, I have heard this supreme and most secret Yoga, directly from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it.

nodes.label: BG 18.76
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: O King, remembering this wonderful and holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I continually rejoice.

nodes.label: BG 18.77
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.snippet: And, remembering again and again that most wonderful form of Hari, I am filled with great wonder, O King; and I rejoice again and again.

nodes.label: BG 18.78
nodes.speaker: sanjaya
nodes.sa: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः
nodes.snippet: Wherever Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, is; and wherever Arjuna, the wielder of the bow, is; there is prosperity, victory, happiness, and a firm policy; this is my conviction.

nodes.label: Dharma
nodes.desc: The sustaining law of things — cosmic order, moral rightness and one's rightful duty. The Gita opens on the 'field of dharma' (1.1) and closes with the call to go beyond all formulations of it in surrender (18.66).

nodes.label: Svadharma
nodes.desc: The duty that arises from one's own nature and station. 'Better one's own dharma, though imperfect, than the dharma of another well performed' (3.35, 18.47).

nodes.label: Lokasaṅgraha
nodes.desc: Acting for the cohesion and uplift of society. The wise act without attachment to set an example: 'whatever the great do, others follow' (3.21).

nodes.label: Ahiṃsā
nodes.desc: Non-injury in thought, word and deed, listed among the divine qualities (16.2) and the austerities of the body (17.14).

nodes.label: Satya
nodes.desc: Truth in speech and being; speech that is true, pleasing and beneficial is the austerity of speech (17.15).

nodes.label: Daivī sampat
nodes.desc: The twenty-six qualities that lead to liberation — fearlessness, purity, charity, self-control, compassion, humility and more (16.1–3).

nodes.label: Āsurī sampat
nodes.desc: Hypocrisy, arrogance, conceit, anger, harshness and ignorance — the qualities that bind (16.4), whose inner monologue is dissected in 16.13–16.

nodes.label: Varṇa
nodes.desc: The fourfold order 'created according to the division of guṇa and karma' (4.13) — qualities and work, which the Gita describes in terms of inner nature (18.41–44).

nodes.label: Karma
nodes.desc: Action, and the moral law of action. 'Karma is the creative force that brings beings into existence' (8.3); its course is 'unfathomable' (4.17).

nodes.label: Akarma
nodes.desc: The subtle teaching that the wise 'see inaction in action and action in inaction' (4.18) — freedom is not abstention but non-doership.

nodes.label: Niṣkāma karma
nodes.desc: Action performed as duty without craving for its fruit: 'Your right is to action alone, never to its fruits' (2.47). The heart of Karma Yoga.

nodes.label: Karmayoga
